newsitem.title: USA: GTE to offer Internet access in 120 markets.
newsitem.headline: GTE to offer Internet access in 120 markets.

text.p: GTE Corp said Thursday it will start offering Internet access in 120 new markets over the next four months, with more than half of them in GTE's wireline and wireless serving territory.

GTE said it will double, and in many cases quadruple, by July the amount of dial-up capacity in all 381 markets where it provides GTE Internet Solutions so that it can increase its customer base to 400,000 by year's end.
The company said earlier today the number of its Internet subscribers has grown to over 100,000 since it introduced its nationwide access service in July, 1996.
Also as part of the expansion plan, GTE said it will install more than 200,000 modems around the country.
